a.lede: Endpoint management platforms can become powerful attack tools when compromised, allowing hackers to deploy malware, execute commands, and disrupt thousands of devices. Action1 explains how customer-controlled cryptographic authorization can prevent attackers from abusing sensitive endpoint operations. [...]
a.title: Your Endpoint Management Platform Could Be Your Biggest Security Risk

b.lede: Multiple threat actors are abusing GSocket, a legitimate open-source remote access tool, to maintain access to Linux servers even after patching the vulnerabilities exploited to gain initial access. [...]
b.title: Hackers plant GSocket on Linux servers for persistent access
